blocks.content: Inbound SCIM provisioning is a realm-level feature. Click the button below to confirm your realm administrator has enabled it. If not, ask the admin to enable SCIM in the organizations configuration.

steps.title: Create an Entra ID Enterprise Application

blocks.content: Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center.
In the left navigation menu, expand the Entra ID section and select the Enterprise applications tab. Click New application.

blocks.alt: Enterprise applications page with the New application button visible

blocks.content: On the Browse Microsoft Entra App Gallery page, click Create your own application. Enter a descriptive app name (for example, the name of the realm being provisioned). Select Integrate any other application you don't find in the gallery (Non-gallery) and click Create.

blocks.alt: Browse Microsoft Entra App Gallery with the Create your own application form

blocks.content: Your new application now appears in the Enterprise applications list.

blocks.alt: Enterprise applications list with the newly created Example App

blocks.content: Click the button below. The wizard generates a high-entropy Bearer token and writes the SCIM configuration to this organization. The token is shown on the next step — copy it before leaving.

steps.title: Paste the credentials into Entra ID

blocks.content: Open your application in the Entra admin center. In the left navigation under Manage, select Provisioning.

blocks.alt: Example App Overview page with the Provisioning entry in the left navigation

blocks.content: On the Get started page, click Connect your application.

blocks.alt: Provisioning Get started page with the Connect your application button

blocks.content: Under Admin credentials, ensure the authentication method is set to Bearer authentication. Paste the values below into the Tenant URL and Secret token fields, then click Test connection.

blocks.label: Tenant URL
blocks.hint: Paste into the Tenant URL field in Admin credentials

blocks.label: Secret Token
blocks.warning: Copy this value now — it cannot be recovered later. Anyone holding it can push users and groups into this organization.
blocks.hint: Paste into the Secret token field in Admin credentials

blocks.alt: Admin credentials form with Bearer authentication, Tenant URL, Secret token, and Test connection button

blocks.content: Once the connection test succeeds, click Create to save the configuration.
On the Provisioning tab, expand the Mappings section. You'll see two mappings: Provision Microsoft Entra ID Groups and Provision Microsoft Entra ID Users.

blocks.alt: Provisioning page with Mappings section expanded

blocks.content: Click Provision Microsoft Entra ID Users to open the Attribute Mapping editor.

blocks.alt: Mappings section with the Provision Microsoft Entra ID Users link highlighted

blocks.content: Confirm Enabled is Yes, and that Target Object Actions has Create, Update, and Delete all checked.

blocks.alt: Attribute Mapping editor showing Enabled toggle and Target Object Actions checkboxes

blocks.content: Scroll down to the externalId mapping. If it is not already mapped to objectId, click Edit, then select objectId from the Source attribute dropdown and click Ok.

blocks.alt: Edit Attribute dialog with Source attribute set to objectId and Ok button

blocks.content: Click Save at the top, then Yes in the Save changes dialog to confirm.

blocks.alt: Save changes confirmation dialog with Yes button

blocks.content: Review the full attribute mapping list. The defaults shown below should work for most realms — adjust only if your realm uses non-standard user attributes.

blocks.alt: Attribute Mapping list showing default Entra ID to SCIM attribute mappings

blocks.content: In your Entra application, go to Users and groups and click Add user/group.

blocks.alt: Users and groups page with the Add user/group button

blocks.content: On the Add Assignment screen, click None Selected under Users.

blocks.alt: Add Assignment page with None Selected highlighted

blocks.content: Search for and select each user who should be provisioned. Click Select.

blocks.alt: Users dialog with a user selected and the Select button

blocks.content: When finished, click Assign.

blocks.alt: Add Assignment page showing 1 user selected and the Assign button

blocks.content: Return to the Provisioning tab. Under Settings, set Scope to Sync only assigned users and groups, then toggle Provisioning Status to On. Entra will start pushing users within a few minutes.

blocks.alt: Provisioning Settings showing Scope set to Sync only assigned users and groups, and Provisioning Status On

blocks.title: SCIM provisioning is configured
blocks.description: Entra ID will start pushing users and groups within a few minutes. Sync events appear in the Keycloak admin console under Events.
